Container.Name: TrunkScope
Container.Overview: Self-hosted receive-only SDR scanner. Pass a USB SDR and one appdata folder; the container serves the operator console, control plane, and Trunk Recorder P25/FM decoder on a single port. Public feeds stay disabled. Encrypted calls keep metadata only. Optional transcription/summary talk to existing Ollama or Whisper containers — they are not bundled.
Container.Requires: USB SDR (RTL-SDR, Airspy, or SDRplay with vendor runtime mounted at /opt/sdrplay). Keep the published port on a trusted LAN/VPN.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port for the TrunkScope console (18088 avoids the common Unraid 8088 collision).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent settings, decoder config, and call recordings.

Config.Name: USB SDR
Config.Description: Pass the host USB bus to the container so a local RTL-SDR, Airspy, or SDRplay can be opened.

Config.Name: SDRplay runtime
Config.Description: Optional licensed SDRplay API runtime (for example /mnt/user/appdata/trunkscope/sdrplay). Leave empty for RTL-SDR or Airspy.

Config.Name: Radio mode
Config.Description: decoder uses Trunk Recorder for P25/FM. Use simulator only for a hardware-free smoke test.

Config.Name: Local-only access
Config.Description: When true, skip login and grant administrator access to anyone who can reach the port. Disable on any untrusted network.

Config.Name: Site filter
Config.Description: Optional site-name substring filter for imported P25 systems (for example Black River Falls).

Config.Name: Radio device
Config.Description: Soapy/osmosdr device string. Examples: soapy=0,driver=rtlsdr or soapy=0,driver=sdrplay

Config.Name: Sample rate Hz
Config.Description: Capture sample rate used when generating Trunk Recorder source config.

Config.Name: Summary URL
Config.Description: Optional Ollama generate endpoint, for example http://192.168.1.4:11434/api/generate

Config.Name: Summary model
Config.Description: Ollama model name when TRUNKSCOPE_SUMMARY_URL is set.

Config.Name: AI enabled
Config.Description: Enable transcription and summary workers. Requires the transcribe/summary URLs.
